{"proof":"  have hS : S = ({-14, 8} : Finset ℝ) := by
    ext x
    rw [h₀]
    simp only [Finset.mem_insert, Finset.mem_singleton]
    constructor
    · intro h
      have hprod : (x + 14) * (x - 8) = 0 := by nlinarith
      rcases mul_eq_zero.mp hprod with h | h
      · left
        linarith
      · right
        linarith
    · rintro (h | h) <;> subst x <;> norm_num
  rw [hS]
  norm_num"}
